title: audit logger channel/batch/interval hardcoded as magic numbers; not configurable
description: audit.rs build_audit_logger hardcodes channel_size=1000, batch_size=100, flush_interval=5s. These are not exposed in any config struct. Under high event rates the channel fills (events dropped) or under low rates the 5s flush delay makes audit records stale. These should be operator-configurable fields in AuditConfig. The magic numbers also make the drop threshold invisible in config documentation.
